description: Guided opt-out fer Spy Dialer, which lists folk by phone number. One opt-out covers every saved phone number.
instructions: Open https://www.spydialer.com/ an' click, matey, "Do Not Sell Or Share My Personal Information" at the bottom. Smash Start, choose yer state, finish the robot check, then add {full_name}, yer address, each of these numbers ({all_phones}) an' {email}. Smash "Opt-Out My Info" an' wait fer "Your submitted data has been blocked from future sharing". Then smash "I've done this".
